description: Preview a described clothing or accessory style on a photo of a consenting adult, or edit the garment already in the photo (e.g. 'make the skirt mini', 'navy instead of red'). Returns an AI-generated preview image labeled 'AI preview, not a real photo', plus a link to shop similar items. Requires consent=true: the photo is of the user or an adult who agreed. No minors, nudity, lingerie/swimwear, or photos of celebrities/real people without consent (content policy: https://shopfashion.si/content-policy). Limited to 3 per IP per day and a site-wide daily budget; photos are not stored.

consent.description: Must be true: the user confirms the photo is of themselves or an adult who agreed.

image_base64.description: JPEG/PNG, ≤1.5MB, ≤1024px long side recommended. data: URL prefix allowed.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the image (alternative to base64).

style.description: e.g. 'emerald satin midi dress' or 'shorten the skirt to mini'

name: photo_tryon
title: Photo try-on (AI preview)
